description: MainActivity.kt defines the main entry point of the Android app built with Jetpack Compose. It sets up the UI with a top app bar for month navigation, a transactions table, controls for adding income and expense transactions, and a bottom summary bar updating dynamically. It manages user interactions, state management for transactions, and integrates various UI components.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity class inheriting from ComponentActivity, responsible for setting up and managing the main UI screen of the finance tracker app using Jetpack Compose.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method of AppCompatActivity to initialize the UI components, manage state, and handle user interactions for the main activity.
